## About this pack

<!-- A sentence or two: what it teaches, which ages, how many items. For an update, what changed. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds or updates **one** pack, in `packs/<id>/`.
- [ ] The id is `cm.<my-github-handle>.<pack-name>`, at most 32 characters, and matches the folder name.
- [ ] `ruby scripts/check_packs.rb` says the pack looks good.
- [ ] I made everything in this pack myself, words and pictures, and I dedicate it to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
- [ ] Every picture is a drawing. Any people are simple cartoon figures, never a real person or a realistic face, and nothing is traced from a photo of a person.
- [ ] No real names, addresses, schools, brands, logos, links, or characters that belong to someone else.
- [ ] Nothing scary, mean, gross or shaming, and a wrong answer is never mocked.
- [ ] Every question has exactly one right answer, and the other choices are fair.
- [ ] Facts are true; Moon, planet and Earth facts have a `source` and a `checked` date.
- [ ] Every picture is clear in black and white at tile size.
- [ ] The pack's `README.md` says what it is, which ages, and how to play it together; `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for this version.
- [ ] For an update: `version` went up, `rev` went up on any item whose answer or meaning changed, and no item id was changed or reused.

## For reviewers

Go through every line of the [kid-safety checklist](https://github.com/the3dcoder/rubymoon-community/blob/main/SAFETY.md),
read every item, and look at every picture in the **Files changed** tab.
